name: Agbara

routes.outcome: Official Ogun State OLARMS page describes a state land administration and revenue management system, property registration, land search, and the Bureau of Land and Survey GIS Building as the service address. This establishes a local/state land custodian, not an exposed parcel API.

Official Ogun SDI page describes a state spatial-data infrastructure administered by Ogun State Bureau of Information Technology for land-use, infrastructure, environmental, and geospatial information. No public parcel schema or geometry endpoint was identified.

Official Ogun SDI GeoNode catalogue was reachable to the search index and exposed datasets/maps/document categories, but the public fetch showed no listed parcel layer or downloadable parcel geometry.

Public OLARMS-GIS description states that interactive maps include land parcels and that digitized cadastral maps exist. It is a first-party-linked service description, not proof of an anonymously downloadable parcel response.
TLS-verified curl failed before HTTP response because the server certificate was expired. No certificate-verification bypass was used.
Public fetch returned a JavaScript-app shell ('You need to enable JavaScript to run this app'); no viewer configuration, API URL, schema, CRS, or parcel response was exposed.
Public fetch timed out through the research web route. No retry with credentials, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or unsafe field request was attempted.
Public route discovery reached a cache-miss fetch failure; no viewer configuration, API URL, schema, CRS, or parcel response was exposed.

boundedAnonymousResponse.requestScope: No safe anonymous parcel geometry request was available after first-party discovery and public-shell inspection.

qualification.reason: A local/state cadastral and land-administration custodian is evidenced, but no safe anonymous parcel schema, native identity, CRS, or geometry response was exposed. Adapter qualification remains a separate serial review.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point [6.50433430173984, 3.03723454634413] was preserved in latitude/longitude order; no coordinate shift or parcel-hit forcing was attempted.
Certificate expiry, JavaScript-only shell, timeout, and lack of an exposed parcel response are not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
OLARMS, Ogun SDI, and OLARMS-GIS are local/state custodial routes; general national-agency prose and non-custodial search results were not treated as the local parcel service.
No GeoJSON sample is retained because no safe anonymous native ID-plus-geometry response was available.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, certificate/title, or personal fields were requested or retained.
Request/page captures and scratch evidence belong under ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/agbara/.
uncertainty: Ogun State publicly describes land administration, land search, digital land records, and cadastral/parcel mapping services, and Agbara lies within Ogun State's service area. Public coverage of Agbara, viewer/API availability, schema, CRS, native identity, update cadence, licensing, and runtime adapter behavior remain unverified because the accessible routes exposed only descriptions or application shells and one route had an expired certificate. No citywide absence inference is made.
